description.id: Puasa wajib selama bulan Ramadan bagi Muslim yang memenuhi syarat.
description.en: The obligatory fast during Ramadan for Muslims who meet its conditions.

description.id: Puasa pengganti untuk hari wajib yang ditinggalkan ketika qada diwajibkan.
description.en: A replacement fast for missed obligatory days when make-up is required.

description.id: Puasa yang menjadi wajib karena nazar yang sah; rincian keabsahannya mengikuti fikih.
description.en: A fast made obligatory by a valid vow; validity details follow jurisprudence.

description.id: Puasa sebagai kafarat pada pelanggaran tertentu, dengan sebab, urutan, dan jumlah hari mengikuti ketentuan masing-masing kasus.
description.en: Fasting as expiation for specified violations, with cause, sequence, and number of days governed by each case.

description.id: Puasa tambahan di luar kewajiban; hari yang dianjurkan dan cara pelaksanaannya mengikuti panduan fikih.
description.en: Additional fasting beyond obligations; recommended days and practice follow juristic guidance.

title.en: Days on Which Fasting Is Prohibited

description.id: Terdapat hari-hari ketika puasa tidak dibolehkan; daftar dan pengecualian rinci harus dirujuk kepada panduan fikih tepercaya.
description.en: There are days on which fasting is not permitted; consult reliable juristic guidance for the detailed list and exceptions.

sources: Consult a competent local religious authority for the detailed prohibited days and exceptions
